nom: Live Tinted Superhue Hyperpigmentation Serum Stick

avis.texte: I initially bought two sticks to try, and by the time I was on my second one, I went back and picked up three more. I really like the SUPERHUE® Hyperpigmentation Serum Stick — highly recommend it.
Great coverage for my hyperpigmentation on my face and hoping to see gradual improvement for a good tone

avis.titre: This is GOLD - SUPERHUE Hyperpigmentation Stick
avis.texte: I don't say this lightly this is one of those rare products that actually lives up to the hype. The SUPERHUE Hyperpigmentation Serum Stick is pure innovation in a swipe and you will feel skin healing from within. The balm-to-serum texture melts instantly into my skin, delivering a targeted treatment that feels both luxurious and incredibly effective. Within weeks, I noticed a visible difference in my crazy dark spots looked softer, uneven patches began to fade, and my overall complexion felt brighter, smoother, and more refined. What I love most is how effortless it is: no mess, no layering confusion, just swipe, blend, and go. It fits seamlessly into even the busiest routines like mine :) The formula feels potent yet gentle, which is a hard balance to strike. Instead of irritating my skin, it worked steadily to reveal a more even, radiant tone. It's not just a spot treatment - it's a confidence boost in a stick. Its always in my purse with me. If hyperpigmentation has been stubborn for you, this is the kind of product that makes you believe results are actually possible again. A true game changer product!!!

I have freckles and have tried multiple products over the years. This one is it! Got rid of my hyperpigmentation immediately and the product itself is so moisturizing and leaves my skin feeling great.

32 y/o female with hormonal acne prone skin. Ive always had sensitive, red, textured skin. Sensitive enough that i have to run every product i purchase through three different acne ingredient checkers and this product has absolutely changed the game for me. It glides on "greasy" but once you rub it in as directed it dries fast and i have really seen such a dramatic difference in my texture, red and dark marks. 10/10

I was excited about this product to help with some hyperpigmentation, but I didnt see much difference. I've previously used Fenty Watch Ya Tone and had pretty good results. Because of the construction of the Fenty product, I was excited to give this a try. I think that I'll stick with the Fenty this time.
I am on my second stick and let me tell you it works wonderfully for lightning your dark spots and gives your skin an even tone overall after a couple weeks with consistency!
I haven't seen any change in my skin since using this product. It goes on easily but hasn't worked for me.
I have an old scar ive been using it on and I notice its much lighter now

I 17/10 recommend this - I have tried lots of others to fade dark spots & scars, but this is the only one that works!! I have darker skin, so one blemish can leave a lasting mark. This makes my skin look like AMAZING & truly does fade away marks!!!

I wouldn't recommend honestly. It doesnt really do whats its supposed to do, and it feels greasy even when using it sparingly it feels like it wont absorb but more so sits on top of the skin. Serums and toners work much better than this. I thought I'd appreciate the convenience of a stick, but if you want a healthy hydrating glow this ruins it.
Me and my husband using this product. . I don't have spots but my husband do, his spots have been cleared after continuous use. We are using this product from the day one it got released.

I also love that it's in stick form, so it's easy to apply without having to touch your face and great for travel too. This is definitely going to be a staple to my skincare routine!

I've been using this since I first purchased and I must say, I LOVE IT! Easy to open. Glides onto the face easily. No awful smell... to me there's no smell. I apply it every evening as during the day I work and use sunscreen n makeup. I apply it towards the inner part of the face and with my fingers, I spread it outwards. On the forehead I glide it from one side to another, and once again with my fingers, I'll spread it towards my hairline. Reason why i did it this way is because at first, I use to glide the stick all over my face and I shine like a diamond (lol). So when I update my method, it absorbed better onto my skin as I also use serums and moisturizers. I know everyone has different skin which can have different results, but if you're open to at least try, then go for it. And yes you may probably think that the worst case scenario is the price of it, however, it would be a one time purchase, but at least you gave it a try. p.s. I ended up buying another stick and one for my daughter (teen) as she has acne marks.

The tube though is kind of wonky and it feels loose when you twist the product BUT the product stays contained! Only giving it a three right now because it hasnt been used for that long yet 🙂

avis.titre: Love this, but the tube is awful
avis.texte: I adore this product, I noticed a significant improvment in my acne scars & dark spots after just a couple weeks of consistant use. The balmy consistancy took some time to get used to, but it's now a staple in my routine. The packaging however is less than ideal. You end up having to dig the product out of the bottom of the tube. The cap is difficult remove & seal properly. Ive been buying the mini's & have purchashed a few tubes where the product came loose & broken. From what I can tell the full size tube is exactly the same, just larger. Again, I love this & will continue to purchase but I really hope the package/applicator is improved.

avis.titre: Must have, my HG, but I hate the tube
avis.texte: Im south asian and i have deep colored skin. I also bruise easily so when i have breakouts im left with dark marks. This product truly works wonders and has cleared up my skin so much. Its hydrating and feels wonderful on my skin, and plays well with other products so layering is never an issue. My only gripe is the tube it comes in. When youve used the stick down to the nub, theres still soooo much product left inside of the tube. Ive been scraping it out using a very small spatula. It just feels wasteful and they should definitely fix the design so you can get more for your money, bc honestly if this product didnt work for me, i wouldnt buy it bc of the cost.

This product is super easy to use, leaves my skin GLOWING after a single use and has noticably faded my hyperpigmentation in anout a month. Not greasy at all, melts into skin very nicely. Definitely will repurchase!
